heroHeadline: OAS Foreign Ministers Demand Nicaragua Free Prisoners and Restore Liberties
heroSubtitle: On Oct. 2 the OAS adopted by consensus a resolution calling for free elections, release of political prisoners and disclosure of the disappeared, with a task force to recommend steps within 60 days. Mexico stayed out, Brazil and Uruguay objected to the 'threat to peace' wording, and the Dominican Republic is closing its Managua embassy.
